summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes execFileSync on the downloaded Bun binary against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line file using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM) and meaningless identifiers; setup.mjs itself uses _0xNNNN-style obfuscated variable names. The package advertises itself as a React admin-layout UI library, dist/index.js does not reference math_init.js, and the obfuscated bundle has no relationship to the declared library surface. The preinstall path executes package-controlled but opaque code under an alternate runtime on the installer's machine before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
